_README: Adjudication of UNTYPED weapon/off-hand proc names for the Utility tier (#91). The candidate rule in src/utility_procs.py is 'untyped + numeric + well-formed + every carrying slot is Weapon/Off Hand' - the deliberate complement of src/untyped_rankable.py's worn-slot rule, so the two gates' populations are disjoint. A candidate in NEITHER list fails the build, so a new untyped weapon proc is a reviewed event rather than a silent zero-count. SINCE #343: 'allow' names enter metadata.utility_untyped_admitted ONLY - the presence-path picker entry that makes them individually rankable. They are NO LONGER unioned into metadata.utility_counting_set, so admitting a name here makes it available to rank, not counted by the Utility tier. Two reasons: a proc is a damage-type decision belonging to the weapon choice rather than a distinct win a player feels, and the 24 admitted procs were 86% of the counting set's measured solve cost - keeping them counted put the tier over its 2.0x perf budget once the worn defensive toggles were added. They NEVER enter metadata.rankable_affixes - a declared-credit control on Holy/Vampirism is the documented defect web/dataset.js warns against.
_discipline: exclude-until-verified. Add to 'allow' ONLY with wiki evidence (wiki_url + evidence + verified date) that the name is a player-felt utility effect worth counting. 'unreviewed' is an honest reason and marks the filed backlog; it is not a judgement that the name is noise. An empty 'allow' list counts zero untyped procs - the Bool presence half of the counting set is unaffected.

quarantined.name: Rune Arm Imbue: Bludgeon IV, Fire
Rune Arm Imbue: Bludgeon V, Fire
Rune Arm Imbue: Fire V, Bludgeon
Increases all threat generated by
quarantined.reason: unreviewed — and the name is a tooltip SENTENCE FRAGMENT, not an enchantment name (`Rahl's Might` carries it as {name: 'Increases all threat generated by', value: '15'} with no type key). Threat generation is a real mechanic, so this may be a genuine utility effect hiding behind an upstream parse gap, but admitting a fragment into the counting set would be wrong either way. Surfaced by the #374 refresh; quarantined pending a wiki read of https://ddowiki.com/page/Item:Rahl's_Might

_retired_2026_08_18.why: #374/U4 — the 2026-08-18 refresh re-encoded the type field and gave these procs a real `Bool` type (two exceptions noted per-entry). They are no longer untyped, so this shard's adjudication cannot apply to them. They continue to count via presence_counting_names, whose PRESENCE_TYPES already includes `Bool`. Retired, not deleted.
